THIS PETITION COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING,
THROUGH PHYSICAL HEARING/VIDEO CONFERENCING THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER 1.

The case of the petitioner is that the land in Survey No.85/P3 measuring 1 acre 38 guntas of Mindahalli village, Mallur Taluk, Kolar District, belonging to him was acquired for the purpose of respondent no.2/Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Board.
Further, respondent no.1 has passed a general award and deposited the compensation in the Reference Court.
He prays that consent award be passed in respect of the said land.

The learned counsel appearing for the respondents submit that they have no objection to pass a consent award provided the petitioner produces all the relevant documents to show that he is the owner of the property.

3. Under similar circumstances, this Court in umpteen number of cases has permitted the land losers to claim compensation as per the consent award upon establishing the fact that they are the owners of the property.
There is no reason why a similar order should not be passed in the instant case also.
